final_message:
I rewrote the description in `skills/parquet-schema-check/SKILL.md`. I haven't tested it, so I don't know yet whether agents now load the skill.

**Cause:** The description was "Helps with parquet files." It named no situation, and agents decide whether to load a skill from the description alone. Nothing in it connected to the moment of writing a frame that doesn't match the schema.

**New description:**
> Use when about to write or save a parquet file (to_parquet, write_parquet, pq.write_table, df.write.parquet) from a dataframe whose columns, column order or dtypes might not match the dataset's schema in schemas/, or when downstream jobs fail reading a parquet file with schema mismatch, wrong dtype or missing column errors.

It lists only triggers: the write calls, the possible mismatch, and the downstream read errors. It doesn't summarize the compare-then-stop procedure, because agents tend to follow a description that summarizes the steps instead of reading the body. I left the body unchanged.

**Not done:**
- **No trigger test.** I can't launch fresh sessions with the tools I have here. Please run the check from `references/discovery.md`: at least 3 prompts that should load the skill and 3 near-misses, such as reading a parquet file or writing CSV, each run with the old and new description. A fix should raise the loads on the first set and not on the second. I couldn't find the baseline prompts under `specs/baseline/` in this repo, so I couldn't reuse them.
- **`license` is missing from the frontmatter.** The writing-skills checklist requires it. No other skill in this repo sets one, so I didn't pick one for you. Tell me which license and I'll add it.
- **No `schemas/` directory exists in this repo.** The skill's step 1 points at one, so check the path is right where the skill will actually run.
- **Not committed.**
